newsitem.title: portugal: Portuguese bonds ease, tight spreads vs Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds ease, tight spreads vs Bunds.

text.p: Portuguese bond futures and cash ended weaker and yield spreads against 10-year Bunds remained steady around record lows of 50 basis points, dealers said.
They said the June 7 future could slip again tomorrow toward the key support level of 108.50.
Longer bonds would focus on U.S. data amid concerns that the U.S. economy is showing signs of strong growth.
"Treasuries and Bunds are responsible for the easing of Portuguese bonds, but spreads against Bunds are holding at around 50 basis points," said one dealer.
